howItWorksPage.heroDesc: We provide customized processes for both sellers and space providers. No complicated procedures — start quickly and easily.
howItWorksPage.sellerTitle: How to Use as a Seller

sellerStep1.title: Sign Up
sellerStep1.desc: Create a seller account easily with just your email and basic info. Enter your business number, brand name, category, etc.

sellerStep2.title: Browse Spaces & Apply
sellerStep2.desc: Find spaces matching your criteria on the vendor search page. Apply to your favorite spaces directly.

sellerStep3.title: Match & Start Operations
sellerStep3.desc: Once the space provider approves your application, matching is complete. Manage all your entry status in real-time from your dashboard.

howItWorksPage.vendorTitle: How to Use as a Vendor

vendorStep1.title: Register Your Space
vendorStep1.desc: Register your space information. Enter details like location, size, type, price, commission rate, and upload photos.
details: Easy location entry via address search

vendorStep2.title: Search Sellers & Recruit
vendorStep2.desc: Search for brands on the seller directory and find sellers suited for your space. Quickly filter by category!

vendorStep3.title: Approve & Manage
vendorStep3.desc: Review and approve/reject seller applications. Manage entry status and recruitment progress for each space from your dashboard.

faq.q: Are there any signup or usage fees?
faq.a: Registration and basic service usage are free. Premium features will be announced later.

faq.q: What types of spaces can be registered?
faq.a: You can register various types including popup stores, galleries, cafes, showrooms, department store popup zones, and shared offices.

faq.q: How long does approval take after applying?
faq.a: Since the space provider reviews applications directly, processing time may vary. Typically, you can expect results within 1-3 business days.

faq.q: Can I apply to multiple spaces at once?
faq.a: Yes, sellers can apply to multiple spaces simultaneously. Manage all application statuses at a glance from your dashboard.
